from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data for the section
        title = "The Formal Equation: Mapping Geometry to Algebra"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Let’s translate this visual stretching into a formal equation.",
            "Bayes' Theorem calculates the ratio of these specific areas.",
            "The numerator is the \"True Positive\" region we kept.",
            "The denominator is the total area of the evidence.",
            "Algebra confirms what our geometry just demonstrated."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Define colors
        COLOR_H = BLUE_B # Hypothesis
        COLOR_E = GREEN_B # Evidence
        COLOR_TP = BLUE_D # True Positive
        COLOR_FP = RED_D # False Positive
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(H|E) = \\frac{P(E|H)P(H)}{P(E)}",
            substrings_to_isolate=["P(E|H)P(H)", "P(E)"],
            color=WHITE, font_size=36
        )
        self.place_in_area(formula, "A2", "A5")
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Geometry rectangles
        rect_tp = Rectangle(width=2.0, height=1.2, fill_opacity=0.8, fill_color=COLOR_TP, stroke_color=WHITE)
        rect_fp = Rectangle(width=0.8, height=1.2, fill_opacity=0.8, fill_color=COLOR_FP, stroke_color=WHITE)
        
        label_tp = Text("True Positive (0.18)", font_size=16, color=WHITE)
        label_fp = Text("False Positive (0.08)", font_size=16, color=WHITE)
        
        tp_group = VGroup(rect_tp, label_tp).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        fp_group = VGroup(rect_fp, label_fp).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        geo_group = VGroup(tp_group, fp_group).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)
        self.place_in_area(geo_group, "B2", "D5")
        
        self.play(FadeIn(geo_group))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        numerator = formula.get_part_by_tex("P(E|H)P(H)")
        numerator_rect = SurroundingRectangle(numerator, color=YELLOW, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(numerator_rect))
        self.play(Indicate(rect_tp))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(numerator_rect))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        denominator = formula.get_part_by_tex("P(E)")
        denominator_rect = SurroundingRectangle(denominator, color=YELLOW, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(denominator_rect))
        self.play(Indicate(geo_group)) 
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(denominator_rect))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        calc_formula = MathTex(
            "P(H|E) = \\frac{0.18}{0.18 + 0.08}",
            color=WHITE, font_size=36
        )
        self.place_in_area(calc_formula, "E2", "E5")
        
        result_text = MathTex(
            "P(H|E) \\approx 0.69 \\text{ (69\\%)}",
            color=YELLOW, font_size=40
        )
        self.place_in_area(result_text, "F2", "F5")
        
        self.play(FadeIn(calc_formula))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Write(result_text))
        
        # Visual transition: emphasis on the True Positive being the majority now
        self.play(
            rect_tp.animate.set_fill(opacity=1.0).scale(1.1),
            rect_fp.animate.set_fill(opacity=0.2),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout
        title = "Bayes' Theorem & Geometry of Belief"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- Prior: Initial belief P(H)",
            "- Evidence: New data observed",
            "- Likelihood: P(E|H)",
            "- Posterior: Updated belief P(H|E)",
            "- Geometry: Overlap of areas"
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # 2. Bayes Formula
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(H|E) = \\frac{P(E|H)P(H)}{P(E)}",
            color=YELLOW
        )
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "A3", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. Geometric Representation (Unit Square)
        square = Square(side_length=3, stroke_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(square, "D3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Prior area (P(H))
        prior_rect = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=3, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_width=1)
        prior_rect.move_to(square.get_left(), aligned_edge=LEFT)
        prior_label = Text("P(H)", font_size=16).next_to(prior_rect, UP, buff=0.1)

        # Likelihood area (P(E|H) portion of H)
        likelihood_rect = Rectangle(width=1.5, height=1.2, fill_color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=1)
        likelihood_rect.move_to(prior_rect.get_bottom(), aligned_edge=BOTTOM)
        likelihood_label = Text("P(E|H)", font_size=14, color=GREEN).move_to(likelihood_rect)

        # Evidence (P(E)) - horizontal slice across the square
        evidence_line = Line(square.get_left(), square.get_right(), color=RED).shift(UP * 0.5)
        evidence_label = Text("Evidence Boundary", font_size=14, color=RED).next_to(evidence_line, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        # 4. Animations
        self.play(Create(square))
        self.play(FadeIn(prior_rect), Write(prior_label))
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(likelihood_rect))
        self.play(Write(likelihood_label))
        self.wait(1)

        self.play(Create(evidence_line), Write(evidence_label))
        
        # Highlight Posterior
        posterior_box = SurroundingRectangle(likelihood_rect, color=YELLOW, buff=0.05)
        self.play(Create(posterior_box))
        
        post_text = Text("Posterior Focus", font_size=18, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(post_text, "F3", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(post_text))
        
        self.wait(3)
